items.name: vv
items.title: vv design system index
items.description: Every item in the vv registry, its tier and when to use it.
items.docs: Start here. Read the items this index names with `npx shadcn view ./registry/r/<item>.json` from web/.

items.name: vv-theme
items.title: vv theme tokens
items.description: Every design-system token (colour roles, type, spacing and sizes, radius, shadow, motion) in web/src/ui/tokens.css.
items.docs: Use only the utility classes these tokens generate. Which role each colour plays and which step to use where: web/registry/rules/foundations.md (item vv-rules).

items.name: vv-rules
items.title: vv design-system rules
items.description: The usage rules of the vv design system, one file per tier.
items.docs: Read foundations.md before choosing a colour, a type step, a spacing step, a radius or a shadow, components.md before choosing, composing or adding a component, and patterns.md before building a screen.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message inside a section: error, warning, done or guidance, with an icon, a title and a description.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: Confirms an action that cannot be undone, with Cancel and an action named by its verb. Uses button.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label: tag chip, count or status.

items.name: brand-home-link
items.title: BrandHomeLink
items.description: vv component: the VVMDM logo in the top bar, linking to the library.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path to the current folder.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Actions: one default (primary) per area, then secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, ghost-destructive and link, in sizes sm, default, lg, icon-sm and icon, and the shapes default and pill.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Turns one option on or off in a form or a selection; has an indeterminate state.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Shows or hides a part of a section from a button, such as the rows inside an expandable card.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Picks one value from many by typing to narrow them: a Command in a popover. Uses button and command.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A list narrowed by what is typed, chosen with the keyboard; the inside of a combobox.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window for a form or a long choice, with a title, a body and a footer. Uses button.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: A list of actions or one choice from a few, opened from a button.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: The empty state of a list or section: icon, reason and the action that fills it.

items.name: favorite-toggle
items.title: FavoriteToggle
items.description: vv component: the favorite heart, mark and toggle in one, for cards, rows and the video page, where it is a pill with its word. Uses toggle and tooltip.

items.name: image-upload-dialog
items.title: ImageUploadDialog
items.description: vv component: the dialog every image upload opens, with a drop zone that also opens the file picker and paste anywhere in it; the caller refuses a file with a reason the dialog shows. Uses dialog, button and alert.

items.name: person-face
items.title: PersonFace
items.description: vv component: a person's face, or the UserRound placeholder in the same frame, in eight shapes (card, profile, chip, token, option, compare, judge, scene); PersonFaceMark places a mark in a corner.

items.name: span-bar
items.title: SpanBar
items.description: vv component: one lane the length of a video with a block per span at its place and width, clamped to the lane; the blocks are buttons when the lane is pressable. Uses button and tooltip.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: One form field: label, control, description and error. Uses label.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A one-line text field.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or search operator in text or a tooltip.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name of a control; pressing it focuses the control.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A non-modal panel anchored to its trigger, for a few options or a short form.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far a known amount of work has come; indeterminate without a value.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Picks one value from a few options that stay visible.

items.name: scrub-preview
items.title: ScrubPreview
items.description: vv component: the card scrub band and frame inside a VideoThumbnail.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Picks one value from a fixed list in a dropdown.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups of controls or sections.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel from the screen's edge; in vv only the sidebar's narrow-width drawer. Uses button.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app's main navigation: expanded, icon rail and narrow-width drawer. Uses button, input, separator, sheet, skeleton and tooltip.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The final layout's shapes while content loads.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a value on a stepped or continuous range, such as the card size.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: The Toaster for short, passive notices sent with toast() from sonner.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A short wait with no measure.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off with immediate effect.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views of the same content in place.

items.name: tag-command
items.title: TagCommand
items.description: vv component: typing a tag name to pick a tag or create one, with the tag-name checks, in a popover, a list below the input or a fixed-height list in a dialog. Uses command.

items.name: credit-command
items.title: CreditCommand
items.description: vv component: typing the name of a person or organization to pick one or create one, with the entity-name checks, in a list below the input or a fixed-height list in a dialog. TagCommand's sibling on the same base. Uses command.

items.name: remote-mark
items.title: RemoteMark
items.description: vv component: the Laptop mark of an item the paired VVMDM holds, with its name in a tooltip and sr-only text. Uses tooltip.

items.name: tentative-mark
items.title: TentativeMark
items.description: vv component: the dashed circle after a tentative tag's name.

items.name: filter-dropdown-button
items.title: FilterDropdownButton
items.description: vv component: an outline sm toolbar button with a filter's name, its current value and a chevron, opening a dropdown-menu; primary-soft when not at its default.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content.

items.name: thumbnail-backdrop
items.title: ThumbnailBackdrop
items.description: vv component: a blurred copy behind a portrait thumbnail.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed, such as an applied filter, in the shapes default and pill.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A row of toggles, exclusive (view mode, sort direction) or independent. Uses toggle.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Names an icon-only control or adds a short hint on hover and focus.

items.name: video-thumbnail
items.title: VideoThumbnail
items.description: vv component: the 16:9 thumbnail frame with duration, progress edge, corner marks and a notice. Uses progress.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns of records: header, body, rows, heads and cells. Put it in a data-table section on a screen.

items.name: density
items.title: Density
items.description: The density a skeleton gives its sections: management (library) or viewing (detail page). Used by patterns only.

items.name: page-column
items.title: PageColumn
items.description: The reading column SettingsPage and RecordPage share: header, optional notice, sections. Used by patterns only.

items.name: list-page
items.title: ListPage
items.description: Page skeleton: header row, toolbar (beside the header from lg with toolbarRow=header), band, body (grid, table or grouped list) with an optional aside column from lg, selection bar.

items.name: admin-table-page
items.title: AdminTablePage
items.description: Page skeleton: header, band (tabs, search, actions), table, selection bar.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: SettingsPage
items.description: Page skeleton: one column of fixed maximum width with titled sections, optionally the list of a settings area's pages beside it and a notice for the whole page.

items.name: record-page
items.title: RecordPage
items.description: Page skeleton: one record to read inside the shell, with a back link, a title that wraps in full, an optional notice and its parts in sections.

items.name: detail-page
items.title: DetailPage
items.description: Page skeleton: header band, main area and an information aside; stacked below lg. Viewing density.

items.name: centered-form
items.title: CenteredForm
items.description: Page skeleton: one card in the centre with title, fields and one submit button.

items.name: steps-page
items.title: StepsPage
items.description: Page skeleton outside the shell: a header band with the logo and a strip of numbered steps (Step 2 of 3 below sm), then one centered column at most 42rem wide with the step's title, description, content, a failure notice and a footer row of Skip and one primary action. Uses brand-home-link.

items.name: form-dialog
items.title: FormDialog
items.description: Dialog skeleton at most 32rem wide (42rem with size="wide"): title, fields, Cancel (optional) and one primary action. Uses dialog.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog
items.description: AlertDialog skeleton: what happens, Cancel and a destructive action named by its verb.

items.name: editor-dialog
items.title: EditorDialog
items.description: Full-viewport dialog skeleton for a task on one image: header band, stage, aside with a footer of main actions. Uses dialog.

items.name: form-page
items.title: FormPage
items.description: Page skeleton for many values saved together on a screen of its own: sticky header band with the actions, a notice line, an aside column and up to two panels that scroll on their own from lg; a sole panel spans both panel columns. FormPageDialog shows it as a modal over the current screen, and its aside may hold inputs that derive the panel values. Uses field and dialog.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: Section: page title, count, description, leading (Back) and the main action.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Section: search, filters, then view controls and actions; view controls collapse into a popover below lg; searchPlacement=end puts the search at the row's end. Uses popover.

items.name: page-section
items.title: PageSection
items.description: Section: a titled card whose direct children are padded, divided rows.

items.name: form-row
items.title: FormRow
items.description: Section: one setting, label and description left, control right; stacked below sm. Uses field.

items.name: fact-list
items.title: FactList
items.description: Section: term and value pairs in two columns; divided rows for a column of figures, or two lists side by side from md.

items.name: card-grid
items.title: CardGrid
items.description: Section: cards at least card-0 to card-3 wide, or card-face for face cards, stretched so both edges line up with the toolbar.

items.name: shelf
items.title: Shelf
items.description: Section: a heading with a count over a wrapping grid of every card of one kind.

items.name: grouped-list
items.title: GroupedList
items.description: Section: rows under headings that stick below the top bar, each group's rows on the page background with no card and no line, groups further apart than rows.

items.name: card-list
items.title: CardList
items.description: Section: a stack of one-line bordered cards on muted, gap-2 apart, in four tones, with fixed columns at the end for the time and the actions; two lines below lg. A card with members has an expand button and shows its member rows inside its border. Uses collapsible, button and tooltip.

items.name: jump-list
items.title: JumpList
items.description: Section: a single-choice list of jump targets in groups divided by separators, with an action after a last divider; a vertical list under a heading from lg and a horizontally scrolling strip of chips below. Uses toggle-group, separator, skeleton and button.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Section: a table on a card with its border. Uses table.

items.name: selection-bar
items.title: SelectionBar
items.description: Section: selected count, Clear selection and bulk actions, stuck to the bottom of the page. Uses tooltip.

items.name: loading-state
items.title: LoadingState
items.description: State: Skeleton shapes of the final grid (face circles with size face), table, grouped list or cards in the body slot. Uses skeleton.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: State: icon, why it is empty, and the action that fills it. Uses empty.

items.name: error-state
items.title: ErrorState
items.description: State: a destructive Alert saying what failed, with Retry. Uses alert.

items.name: load-more-row
items.title: LoadMoreRow
items.description: State: a Spinner row while the next page loads, or an Alert row with Retry when it failed. Uses spinner and alert.

items.name: profile-page
items.title: ProfilePage
items.description: Page skeleton for one subject above its items: a profile spread (face, identity with key figures, and a facts card at the end from lg), then the items, usually as shelves.
